Subject: Procurement intake & preferred payment path for Acme Corp

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so your procurement team can start vendor setup: 

- Preferred commercial path: you mentioned Procurement-led purchase with a PO (vs. card). Can you confirm whether Acme requires an initial one-off PO or a standing PO for the first 12 months?
- Vendor paperwork: we can provide a Redwood vendor packet, W-9 (US), and banking details. Do you prefer to receive those via email, upload to your vendor portal, or have us complete your portal directly?
- Marketplace question: you asked about buying via your cloud marketplace. We support marketplace and direct PO — pricing differs slightly because marketplace fees apply. If marketplace is preferred, we can coordinate with our partnerships team.

Next steps I propose: I’ll drop over a vendor packet and W-9, Marissa (cc) will confirm billing terms and DocuSign link if needed. If you can loop in procurement@acme-corp.com with guidance on portal vs. email attachments, we’ll move quickly.

Thanks —

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
loganw@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement intake & preferred payment path for Acme Corp

Logan —

Appreciate the follow-up and materials. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We will go PO first; standard is a one-off PO per contract signature for new vendors, then renewals are handled via the AP schedule. Net-30 is preferred.
- We require a completed vendor packet (our form) plus a signed W-9 for tax. I attached our procurement intake PDF.
- For marketplace: we typically use marketplace only for quick SaaS buys under $10k annual. This will likely be direct PO.

Can your team supply bank wiring instructions (ACH/routing), and confirm Redwood’s legal entity and tax ID as it should appear on our system?

Thanks —
Jill Thompson
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp
procurement@acme-corp.com

Thanks — that all sounds good. To confirm next steps from Redwood:

Best,
